basic_details.job_title: NIBMG Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 11 Project Associate, Project Scientist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: BRIC-National Institute of Biomedical Genomics (NIBMG), Kalyani, an institute of the Government of India under the Ministry of Science & Technology, Department of Biotechnology, is filling 11 contractual project posts under the DBT-funded IndiaCAN-Twin oral cancer project. The posts are Project Scientist I, Research Associate I, Principal Project Associate, Project Associate II and Project Associate I. Pay ranges from Rs. 31,000 to Rs. 58,000 per month plus 27% HRA, and the appointment is initially for one year. Candidates send a C.V. and the prescribed application form to [email protected] by

how_to_apply: Applications are made by email only.
Fill in the "Application Form for Selection under Research Projects / Studies" attached to the advertisement. Enter the Advt. No., the Project Name and the position applied for.
Attach a photocopy of the relevant category certificate if you belong to SC/ST/OBC. Use a separate sheet for qualification and experience details if the space is not enough.
Merge all the relevant attachments into a single PDF.
Email your C.V. and the application in the prescribed format to [email protected] with a subject line, by 20-11-2026.
If you are applying for more than one position, send a separate application and a separate email for each role.
An application not sent in the prescribed format will not be accepted. Incomplete submissions or applications lacking the specified subject line format will not be considered.

Application in the prescribed format, covering personal details, date of birth as per the Matriculation or equivalent certificate, qualifications in reverse chronological order, NET/GATE details if qualified, experience, and other relevant information such as achievements and publications.
Photocopy of the relevant category certificate (SC/ST/OBC).
Original certificates and testimonials of qualification and experience, to be shown at the time of interview and joining (if selected).
important_instructions: If selected, a candidate must produce all documents in original. If the documents do not truly reflect what is mentioned in the application, the candidature will be cancelled. The institute website, www.nibmg.ac.in, carries further information.

content_sections.heading: About NIBMG Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: BRIC-National Institute of Biomedical Genomics, Kalyani, describes itself as an institute that has created the physical infrastructure and platform technologies to support research, translation and training in biomedical genomics. These posts are "Project Linked Person" positions for extramural projects carried out by the institute. The posts serve the IndiaCAN-Twin project. Its Principal Investigators are Prof. Nidhan K. Biswas and Prof. Analabha Basu, and its Co-Principal Investigator is Dr. Dilip Kumar. The project studies gingivo-buccal oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), the leading cancer among Indian males. It uses multi-omics profiling, longitudinal cohorts and computational genomics pipelines at NIBMG, together with artificial intelligence and digital pathology. The aim is to build predictive Bio-AI frameworks and to find diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers for Indian oral cancer patients.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for every post is a consolidated monthly remuneration, with 27% HRA on top of the amount shown in the vacancy table. For Project Associate I: if no suitable candidate is found with the second essential qualification (CSIR-UGC NET/LS, GATE or an equivalent national-level examination), a candidate who does not have it may be given Rs. 25,000/- + HRA. The positions are contractual. Appointments will be initially for one year, which is extendable depending upon performance, availability of funds and requirements of the project.

content_sections.heading: NIBMG Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the "Nature of Duty" for each post. Multi-omics data integration. Process and make data AI-ready. AI model testing and critically assess the performance. High throughput data analysis and interpretation. Performing wet lab-based molecular biology/functional validation assays. Performing mammalian cell culture-based assays. Assisting in performing multi-omics data generation (library preparation, sequencing). Report writing. Computational duties: Multi-omics data integration. Process and make data AI-ready. AI model testing and critically assess the performance. High throughput data analysis and interpretation and report writing. OR wet-lab duties: Performing wet lab-based molecular biology assays. Performing mammalian cell culture-based assays. Assisting in performing multi-omics data generation (library preparation, sequencing). Report writing. Performing wet lab-based molecular biology/functional validation assays. Maintenance of biosamples in biorepository, record keeping. Inventory management. Record keeping and Report writing. High throughput data QC, analysis and multi-omics data integration. Process and make data AI-ready and testing of AI models. Inventory management. Record keeping and Report writing.

content_sections.text: The interview is online. Only shortlisted candidates will be sent the interview link on TEAMS. Original certificates and testimonials supporting qualification and experience must be shown at the time of interview and at joining. In the declaration on the form, the applicant agrees to bring the original degrees, certificates and other documents for verification at the time of test or interview. The decision of NIBMG in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of application, mode of selection and conduct of interviews will be final and binding on the candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIBMG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies: Project Scientist I (1), Research Associate I (2), Principal Project Associate (2), Project Associate II (2) and Project Associate I (4).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIBMG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The C.V. and application must be emailed to [email protected] by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for NIBMG Project Associate I?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree in Natural or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent, plus CSIR-UGC (NET)/LS or GATE or an equivalent national-level examination conducted by central government agencies.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for NIBMG project posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 56,000 for Project Scientist I, Rs. 58,000 for Research Associate I, Rs. 49,000 for Principal Project Associate, Rs. 35,000 for Project Associate II and Rs. 31,000 for Project Associate I, each plus 27% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. Every post carries 27% HRA in addition to the consolidated remuneration shown for it.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NIBMG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email your C.V. and the application in the prescribed format, with all attachments merged in a single PDF, to [email protected] with a subject line by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NIBMG project posts?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted, and only shortlisted candidates are sent an interview link on TEAMS for an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Are the NIBMG project posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The positions are contractual, initially for one year, and extendable depending upon performance, availability of funds and requirements of the project.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post at NIBMG?
faq.answer: Yes, but you must submit a separate application and send a separate email for each role.

faq.question: Q10. What if I do not have NET or GATE for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: If no suitable candidate with NET/GATE or an equivalent examination is found, a candidate without it may be given Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for Project Associate I.
